summary: Burford Capital filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, announcing a planned private offering of $300 million senior secured notes due 2029 by its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Burford Capital Global Finance LLC, and delivered a conditional notice to redeem all $400 million of its outstanding 6.250% senior notes due 2028 on September 24, 2026. The redemption is conditioned on the issuer receiving at least $300 million of new indebtedness proceeds on or before that date. Burford also flagged possible opportunistic open-market debt purchases. This is ordinary refinancing and de-leveraging activity, not a special situation; watch for pricing and redemption completion risk.
